GM mustard has the genes of a soil bacterium that give the plant the property of pest-resistance to a wide variety of pests. 2. GM mustard has the genes that allow the plant and cross-pollination hybridization. 3. GM mustard has been developed jointly by the IARI and Punjab Agricultural University.
explanation: Only statement 2 correct. GM mustard contains genes for herbicide resistance and male sterility enabling hybridization/cross-pollination not pest-resistance.

subject: Technology
question_text: Consider the following pairs: Terms sometimes seen in news - Context/Topic 1. Belle II experiment - Artificial Intelligence 2. Blockchain technology - Digital/Cryptocurrency 3. CRISPР-Cas9 - Particle Physics
explanation: Statements 2 and 3 correct. Blockchain related to cryptocurrency. CRISPР-Cas9 is gene editing tool (Biology not Particle Physics). Belle II wrong - particle physics experiment not AI.

subject: Climate
question_text: Which of the following statements best describes carbon fertilization?
option_a: Increased plant growth due to increased concentration of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere
option_b: Increased temperature of Earth due to increased concentration of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere
option_c: Increased acidity of oceans as a result of increased concentration of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere
option_d: Adaptation of all living beings on Earth to the climate change brought about by the increased concentration of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere
explanation: Carbon fertilization is phenomenon where increased atmospheric CO2 stimulates plant growth through enhanced photosynthesis.

subject: Technology
question_text: In the context of emerging communication technologies which one of the following terms best applies to the scenario where devices interact automatically based on sensory input?
explanation: Scenario describes Internet of Things where smart devices interconnect and communicate autonomously.

subject: Energy
question_text: With reference to solar power production in India consider the following statements: 1. India is the third largest in the world in the manufacture of silicon wafers used in photovoltaic units. 2. The solar power tariffs are determined by the Solar Energy Corporation of India.
explanation: Only statement 1 correct. India major silicon wafer producer for PV. Statement 2 incorrect - tariffs determined by competitive bidding processes not SECI alone.

subject: History
question_text: The staple commodities of export by the English East India Company from Bengal in the middle of the 18th century were
option_c: Copper silver gold spices and tea
explanation: Cotton silk saltpetre and opium were major EIC exports from Bengal in 18th century.

subject: History
question_text: Which one of the following is a very significant aspect of the Champaran Satyagraha?
option_a: Active all-India participation of lawyers students and women in the National Movement
option_b: Active involvement of Dalit and Tribal communities of India in the National Movement
option_c: Joining of peasant unrest to India's National Movement
option_d: Drastic decrease in the cultivation of plantation crops and commercial crops
explanation: Champaran Satyagraha significant for connecting peasant agricultural grievances to nationalist movement. First major rural non-cooperation campaign.

subject: History
question_text: Who among the following were the founders of the Hind Mazdoor Sabha established in 1948?
option_a: B. Krishna Pillai E.M.S. Namboodiripad and K.C. George
option_b: Jayaprakash Narayan Deen Dayal Upadhyay and M.N. Roy
option_c: C.P. Ramaswamy Iyer K. Kamaraj and Veeresalingam Pantulu
option_d: Ashok Mehta T.S. Ramanujam and G.G. Mehta
explanation: B. Krishna Pillai E.M.S. Namboodiripad and K.C. George founded HMS in 1948 as communist-influenced trade union.

subject: Religion
question_text: With reference to the religious practices in India the Sthanakvasi sect belongs to
explanation: Sthanakvasi is Jain sect rejecting idol worship following ascetic tradition.

subject: Architecture
question_text: With reference to the cultural history of India consider the following statements: 1. White marble was used in making Buland Darwaza and Khankah at Fatehpur Sikri. 2. Red sandstone and marble were used in making Bara Imambara and Rumi Darwaza at Lucknow.
explanation: Neither statement correct. Buland Darwaza at Fatehpur Sikri built in red sandstone not white marble. Bara Imambara primarily brick construction not red sandstone.

subject: History
question_text: Which one of the following foreign travellers elaborately discussed about diamonds and diamond mines of India?
explanation: Jean-Baptiste Tavernier extensively documented Indian diamonds and mining in his detailed travel accounts.

subject: Buddhism
question_text: With reference to Indian history who among the following is a future Buddha yet to come to save the world?
explanation: Maitreya is recognized as Bodhisattva awaiting future incarnation as Buddha to come after Gautama Buddha.

subject: History
question_text: Which one of the following statements does not apply to the system of Subsidiary Alliance introduced by Lord Wellesley?
option_a: To maintain a large standing army at other's expense
option_b: To keep India safe from Napoleonic danger
option_c: To secure a fixed income for the Company
option_d: To establish British paramountcy over the Indian States
explanation: Protecting from Napoleon's threat doesn't apply to Subsidiary Alliance system which was primarily about control and revenue. Other options correctly describe the system.

subject: Education
question_text: Which of the following led to the introduction of English Education in India? 1. Charter Act of 1813 2. General Committee of Public Instruction 1823 3. Orientalist and Anglicist Controversy
explanation: All three factors led to English education: Charter Act (1) opened educational opportunities GCPI (2) recommended English Anglicist-Orientalist debate (3) influenced policy.

subject: Geography
question_text: Which one of the following is an artificial lake?
explanation: Kodaikanal is artificial lake formed by dam construction. Others are natural lakes.

subject: Skill Development
question_text: With reference to Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana consider the following statements: 1. It is the flagship scheme of the Ministry of Labour and Employment. 2. It among other things will also impart training in soft skills entrepreneurship financial and digital literacy. 3. It aims to align the competencies of the unregulated workforce of the country to the National Skill Qualification Framework.
explanation: All statements correct. PMKVY is flagship scheme providing comprehensive skill training including soft skills and aligning to NSQF framework.

subject: History
question_text: In 1920 which of the following changed its name to Swarajya Sabha?
explanation: South Indian Liberal Federation changed name to Swarajya Sabha in 1920.

subject: History
question_text: Which among the following events happened earliest?
option_d: Satyendranath Tagore became the first Indian to succeed in the Indian Civil Services Examination.
explanation: Dinabandhu Mitra's Neeldarpan (1860) happened before other events chronologically.

subject: Environment
question_text: Which of the following is/are the possible consequence/s of heavy sand mining in riverbeds? 1. Decreased salinity in the river 2. Pollution of groundwater 3. Lowering of the water-table
explanation: Statements 2 and 3 correct consequences. Sand mining exposes groundwater to pollution and lowers water table. Salinity typically increases not decreases.

subject: Agriculture
question_text: With reference to agricultural soils consider the following statements: 1. A high content of organic matter in soil drastically reduces its water holding capacity. 2. Soil does not play any role in the sulphur cycle. 3. Irrigation over a period of time can contribute to the salinization of some agricultural lands.
explanation: Only statement 3 correct. High organic matter INCREASES water holding capacity (opposite of 1). Soil crucial in sulphur cycle (opposite of 2). Irrigation salinization occurs correctly in (3).

subject: Environment
question_text: The Partnership for Action on Green Economy (PAGE) a UN mechanism to assist countries transition towards greener and more inclusive economies emerged at
option_a: The Earth Summit on Sustainable Development 2002 Johannesburg
option_b: The United Nations Conference on Sustainable Development 2012 Rio de Janeiro
option_c: The United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change 2015 Paris
option_d: The World Sustainable Development Summit 2016 New Delhi
explanation: PAGE emerged at Rio+20 (UNCSD) 2012 in Rio de Janeiro as mechanism supporting green economy transition.

subject: Technology
question_text: 3D printing has applications in which of the following? 1. Preparation of confectionery items 2. Manufacture of bionic ears 3. Automotive industry 4. Reconstructive surgeries 5. Data processing technologies
explanation: Statements 1 3 and 4 correct. 3D printing used in confectionery manufacturing, automotive production and reconstructive surgery. Statement 2 - bionic ears use different technology. Statement 5 - not data processing technology application.

subject: Geography
question_text: Consider the following statements: 1. The Barren Island volcano is an active volcano located in the Indian territory. 2. Barren Island lies about 140 km east of Great Nicobar. 3. The last time the Barren Island volcano erupted was in 1991 and it has remained inactive since then.
explanation: Statements 1 and 3 correct. Barren Island active volcano in Andaman-Nicobar. Last erupted 1991. Statement 2 incorrect - Barren Island south/southwest of Great Nicobar not east.

subject: Biology
question_text: Why is a plant called Prosopis juliflora often mentioned in news?
option_a: Its extract widely used in cosmetics
option_b: It tends to reduce biodiversity in the area it grows
option_c: Its extract used in synthesis of pesticides
explanation: Prosopis juliflora invasive species reduces native biodiversity where it grows. Major ecological concern in India particularly in arid regions.

subject: Marine Biology
question_text: Consider the following statements: 1. Most of world's coral reefs in tropical waters. 2. Over one-third of world's coral reefs located in Australia Indonesia Philippines territories. 3. Coral reefs host far more animal phyla than tropical rainforests.
explanation: All three statements correct. Tropical distribution correct. Three countries host ~35% of reefs. Coral reefs biodiversity exceeds rainforests per marine biology research.

subject: Climate
question_text: Momentum for Change: Climate Neutral Now initiative launched by
explanation: Initiative launched by UNFCCC Secretariat to promote climate action and sustainable development.

subject: History
question_text: With reference to educational institutions during colonial rule consider the pairs: 1. Sanskrit College Benaras - William Jones 2. Calcutta Madarsa - Warren Hastings 3. Fort William College - Arthur Wellesley
explanation: Statements 1 and 3 correct. William Jones founded Sanskrit College. Arthur Wellesley founded Fort William College. Hastings did NOT found Calcutta Madarsa.

subject: Geography
question_text: Consider the following pairs - Regions and Countries: 1. Catalonia - Spain 2. Crimea - Hungary 3. Mindanao - Philippines 4. Oromia - Nigeria
explanation: Statements 1 and 3 correct. Catalonia in Spain. Mindanao in Philippines. Crimea in Russia NOT Hungary. Oromia in Ethiopia NOT Nigeria.

subject: History
question_text: Consider the following events: 1. First democratically elected communist party government in India State 2. Imperial Bank of India renamed State Bank of India 3. Air India nationalized 4. Goa became part of independent India. Which is correct chronological sequence?
explanation: Correct sequence: Goa joined 1961 (4). SBI renamed 1955 (2). Communist government Kerala 1957 (1). Air India nationalized 1953 (3). Order: 4-2-1-3

subject: Constitutional Law
question_text: Right to Privacy protected as intrinsic part of Right to Life and Personal Liberty. Which correctly implies above in Constitution?
option_b: Article 17 and Directive Principles Part IV
option_c: Article 21 and freedoms guaranteed Part III
explanation: Article 21 (Life Liberty) and Part III (Fundamental Rights) correctly safeguard privacy as extension of personal liberty per Supreme Court.

subject: Agriculture
question_text: Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs announced Minimum Support Price for which? 1. Areca nut 2. Barley 3. Coffee 4. Finger millet 5. Groundnut 6. Sesamum 7. Turmeric
explanation: Statements 1 3 4 5 and 6 correct for MSP announcement. MSP covers major cereals pulses oilseeds specified items but not all agricultural products.

subject: Wildlife
question_text: Pakhui Wildlife Sanctuary located in
explanation: Pakhui Wildlife Sanctuary located in Arunachal Pradesh along Bhutan border. Important habitat for clouded leopards and other wildlife.

subject: Space
question_text: With reference to India's satellite launch vehicles consider: 1. PSLV launches earth resource monitoring satellites while GSLV mainly launches communication satellites 2. PSLV satellites appear fixed in same sky position 3. GSLV Mk III four-stage with solid motors (1st 3rd) liquid engines (2nd 4th)
explanation: Only statement 1 correct. PSLV for earth observation GSLV for communication correct. Statement 2 false - PSLV satellites not geostationary. Statement 3 accurate but statement 2 disqualifies C option.

subject: Banking
question_text: With reference to governance of public sector banking in India consider: 1. Capital infusion into PSBs by Government increased in last decade 2. Associate banks merged with parent State Bank of India to streamline operations.
explanation: Both statements correct. Government steadily increased capital infusion to PSBs. SBI associate banks (United Central Oriental) merged with parent bank for efficiency.

subject: Media
question_text: Following terms related to media/news - which correctly matched? 1. Belle II experiment - AI 2. Blockchain - Digital/Crypto currency 3. CRISPР-Cas9 - Particle Physics
explanation: Statements 2 and 3 partially correct but statement 1 wrong. Belle II particle physics experiment NOT AI. Blockchain correctly digital/cryptocurrency. CRISPР-Cas9 gene editing (biology NOT particle physics) but context-correct.

subject: Ecology
question_text: Consider the following statements: 1. Global coral reef distribution concentrated in warm tropical waters 2. Coral reefs cover less than 0.1% ocean floor but support 25% marine species 3. Australia Indonesia Philippines Philippines host majority global coral reefs
explanation: All three correct. Coral reefs tropical distribution. Despite tiny area host disproportionate biodiversity. Three countries hold significant reef percentage.

subject: Polity
question_text: Consider the statements about constitutional protection of minorities: 1. Articles 15 and 16 ensure equality regardless of religion caste 2. Article 29 guarantees minorities right to preserve culture language script 3. Article 30 grants minorities right to establish manage educational institutions
explanation: All three statements correct. Article 15 16 equality provisions. Article 29 minority cultural protection. Article 30 minority education rights. Comprehensive constitutional framework for minority protection.

subject: Urban Development
question_text: Considering smart city development and urban digital infrastructure: 1. IoT enables interconnected city systems for traffic transport monitoring 2. 5G technology necessary for smart city real-time data transmission 3. Smart cities require integration of renewable energy systems 4. Blockchain technology used for transparent urban governance records
explanation: All four statements correct for smart city development. IoT connectivity. 5G communication essential. Renewable energy integration. Blockchain transparency. Comprehensive approach to modern urban development.

subject: Polity
question_text: With reference to the Parliament of India consider the following statements: 1. A private member's bill is a bill presented by a Member of Parliament who is not elected but only nominated by the President of India. 2. Recently a private member's bill has been passed in the Parliament of India for the first time in its history.
explanation: Private member's bills can be introduced by any MP (elected or nominated). No private member's bill has been passed in Parliament in recent history. Both statements are incorrect.

subject: History
question_text: With reference to the difference between the culture of Rigvedic Aryans and Indus Valley people which of the following statements is/are correct? 1. Rigvedic Aryans used coat of mail and helmet in warfare whereas Indus Valley people did not leave evidence of using them. 2. Rigvedic Aryans knew gold silver copper whereas Indus Valley people knew only copper and iron. 3. Rigvedic Aryans had domesticated horse whereas there is no evidence of Indus Valley people having been aware of this animal.
explanation: Statement 1 is correct - Rigvedic texts mention armor while IVC has no such evidence. Statement 2 is incorrect - IVC knew gold silver copper not iron. Statement 3 is correct - horse domestication is Aryan.

subject: Ecology
question_text: From the ecological point of view which one of the following assumes importance in being a good link between the Eastern Ghats and the Western Ghats?
explanation: Sathyamangalam Tiger Reserve in Tamil Nadu acts as crucial corridor connecting Eastern and Western Ghats facilitating wildlife movement.

subject: Government Schemes
question_text: Recognition of Prior Learning Scheme is sometimes mentioned in the news with reference to
option_a: Certifying skills acquired by construction workers through traditional channels
option_b: Enrolling persons in Universities for distance learning programmes
option_c: Reserving some skilled jobs to rural and urban poor in some public sector undertakings
option_d: Certifying skills acquired by trainees under National Skill Development Programme
explanation: Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) under National Skill Development Programme certifies skills acquired through informal or non-formal learning including work experience.

subject: Political Theory
question_text: One of the implications of equality in society is the absence of
explanation: Equality implies absence of special privileges for certain groups. It does not mean absence of restraints competition or ideology which can exist in equal societies.

subject: Conservation
question_text: Consider the following statements in respect of Trade Related Analysis of Fauna and Flora in Commerce (TRAFFIC): 1. TRAFFIC is a bureau under United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP). 2. The mission of TRAFFIC is to ensure that trade in wild plants and animals is not a threat to the conservation of nature.
explanation: TRAFFIC is a joint program of WWF and IUCN not a UNEP bureau. Statement 1 is incorrect. Statement 2 correctly describes TRAFFIC's mission to monitor wildlife trade.

subject: Constitutional Law
question_text: Which principle among the following was added to the Directive Principles of State Policy by the 42nd Amendment to the Constitution?
option_a: Equal pay for equal work for both men and women
option_b: Participation of workers in management of industries
option_c: Right to work education and public assistance
option_d: Securing living wage and human conditions of work to workers
explanation: The 42nd Amendment (1976) added four new DPSPs including Article 43A on participation of workers in management of industries.

subject: Political Philosophy
question_text: Which one of the following statements is correct?
option_a: Rights are claims of the State against the citizens
option_b: Rights are privileges which are incorporated in the Constitution of a State
option_c: Rights are claims of the citizens against the State
option_d: Rights are privileges of a few citizens against the many
explanation: Rights are entitlements or claims that citizens have against the state to ensure their well-being and development. The state is obligated to protect these rights.

subject: International Organization
question_text: Which of the following gives Global Gender Gap Index ranking to the countries of the world?
explanation: The Global Gender Gap Report is published annually by the World Economic Forum (WEF) measuring gender-based gaps in access to resources and opportunities.

subject: Technology
question_text: Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding Smart India Hackathon 2017? 1. It is a centrally sponsored scheme for developing every city into Smart Cities in a decade. 2. It is an initiative to identify new digital technology innovations for solving problems faced by our country. 3. It is a programme aimed at making all financial transactions completely digital in a decade.
explanation: Smart India Hackathon is an initiative by MHRD to provide platform for students to give digital solutions to India's problems. Only statement 2 is correct.

subject: Economics
question_text: Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC)? 1. It decides the RBI's benchmark interest rates. 2. It is a 12-member body including Governor of RBI and is reconstituted every year. 3. It functions under chairmanship of Union Finance Minister.
explanation: MPC has 6 members (not 12) headed by RBI Governor (not Finance Minister). It decides benchmark policy rate. Only statement 1 is correct.

subject: Culture
question_text: With reference to Manipuri Sankirtana consider the following statements: 1. It is a song and dance performance. 2. Cymbals are the only musical instruments used in the performance. 3. It is performed to narrate the life and deeds of Lord Krishna.
explanation: Manipuri Sankirtana is song-dance performance on Krishna's life (statements 1 and 3 correct). Besides cymbals drums called pung are also used (statement 2 incorrect).

subject: History
question_text: Who among the following was/were associated with the introduction of Ryotwari Settlement in India during British rule? 1. Lord Cornwallis 2. Alexander Read 3. Thomas Munro
explanation: Ryotwari system was introduced by Alexander Read in Baramahal and later extended by Thomas Munro in Madras. Lord Cornwallis introduced Permanent Settlement.

subject: Environmental Science
question_text: In the context of solving pollution problems what is/are the advantage/advantages of bioremediation technique? 1. It is a technique for cleaning up pollution by enhancing the same biodegradation process that occurs in nature. 2. Any contaminant with heavy metals such as cadmium and lead can be readily and completely treated by bioremediation using microorganisms. 3. Genetic engineering can be used to create microorganisms specifically designed for bioremediation.
explanation: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Bioremediation enhances natural biodegradation and GMOs can be designed for it. Statement 2 is incorrect as heavy metals cannot be completely treated.

subject: Labour History
question_text: The Trade Disputes Act of 1929 provided for
option_a: the participation of workers in the management of industries
option_b: arbitrary powers to the management to quell industrial disputes
option_c: an intervention by the British Court in the event of a trade dispute
option_d: a system of tribunals and a ban on strikes
explanation: Trade Disputes Act 1929 established tribunals for dispute resolution and banned strikes in public utility services during dispute resolution process.

subject: Political Science
question_text: Local self-government can be best explained as an exercise in
explanation: Local self-government represents democratic decentralization where power is devolved to local bodies with elected representatives making decisions for local communities.

subject: Constitutional Law
question_text: Consider the following statements: With reference to the Constitution of India the Directive Principles of State Policy constitute limitations upon 1. legislative function 2. executive function
explanation: DPSPs are not enforceable by courts and do not create legal limitations on legislature or executive. They are guidelines for state policy.

subject: International Economics
question_text: The term Digital Single Market Strategy seen in the news refers to
explanation: Digital Single Market Strategy is European Union initiative to remove regulatory barriers and facilitate digital cross-border activities in EU member states.

subject: Geography
question_text: At one of the places in India if you stand on the seashore and watch the sea you will find that sea water recedes from shore line a few kilometres and comes back to the shore twice a day and you can actually walk on sea floor when water recedes. This unique phenomenon is seen at
explanation: Chandipur beach in Odisha experiences extreme tidal recession where sea water recedes up to 5 km twice daily creating unique walking-on-seabed phenomenon.

subject: Constitutional Law
question_text: With reference to Prohibition of Benami Property Transactions Act 1988 (PBPT Act) consider the following statements: 1. A property transaction is not treated as benami transaction if owner of property is not aware of the transaction. 2. Properties held benami are liable for confiscation by Government. 3. The Act provides for three authorities for investigations but does not provide for any appellate mechanism.
explanation: Statement 1 is incorrect - awareness is not criterion. Statement 2 is correct - benami properties can be confiscated. Statement 3 is incorrect - appellate mechanism exists.

subject: Ecology
question_text: If for some reasons number of butterfly species decreases dramatically what could be the potential consequences? 1. Pollination of some plants could be adversely affected. 2. Some crop plants could have severe fungal infections. 3. There could be decline in population of wasps spiders and birds.
explanation: Butterflies are important pollinators (statement 1 correct) and are food for wasps spiders birds (statement 3 correct). No direct link to fungal infections (statement 2 incorrect).

subject: Biotechnology
question_text: Algae-based biofuels production is possible but what are the potential limitations for developing countries in promoting this industry? 1. Algae-based biofuels can be produced only in oceans not on continents. 2. Establishment of algae-based biofuel production requires high-level expertise/technology until construction is complete. 3. For economically viable production large-scale facilities are required which may raise ecological and social concerns.
explanation: Statement 1 is incorrect - algae farming possible on land. Statements 2 and 3 are correct regarding high technology requirements and large-scale facility concerns.

subject: Social Welfare
question_text: Which of the following are objectives of National Nutrition Mission? 1. Creating awareness relating to malnutrition among pregnant women and lactating mothers. 2. Reducing incidence of anaemia among young children adolescent girls and women. 3. Promoting consumption of millets coarse cereals and unrefined rice. 4. Promoting consumption of poultry eggs.
explanation: National Nutrition Mission objectives include awareness about malnutrition (1)
column13: and nutrition through eggs (4). Promoting specific grains is not primary objective.

subject: Labour History
question_text: Consider the following statements: 1. The Factory Act 1881 was passed with a view to fix wages of industrial workers and allow workers to form trade unions. 2. N.M. Lokhande was a pioneer in organizing labour movement in British India.
explanation: Statement 1 is incorrect - Factory Act 1881 was about working conditions and child labour not wages or unions. Statement 2 is correct about N.M. Lokhande.

subject: Environment
question_text: In context of mitigating impending global warming due to anthropogenic emissions of carbon dioxide which of the following can be potential sites for carbon sequestration? 1. Abandoned and uneconomic coal seams 2. Depleted oil and gas reservoirs 3. Subterranean deep saline formations
explanation: All three are potential carbon sequestration sites - abandoned coal seams depleted oil/gas reservoirs and deep saline aquifers can store CO2.

subject: History
question_text: The object of the Butler Committee of 1927 was to
option_a: Define jurisdiction of Central and Provincial Governments
option_b: Define powers of Secretary of State for India
option_d: Improve relationship between Government of India and Indian States
explanation: Butler Committee (1927) examined relations between Government of India and Indian Princely States recommending direct relations between Crown and Princes.

subject: Trade Policy
question_text: The term Domestic Content Requirement is sometimes seen in news with reference to
option_a: Developing solar power production in our country
option_b: Granting licences to foreign T.V. channels in our country
option_c: Exporting our food products to other countries
option_d: Permitting foreign educational institutions to set up their campuses in our country
explanation: Domestic Content Requirement in context of India's solar mission mandates minimum percentage of domestically manufactured components in solar projects.

subject: International Relations
question_text: Consider the following statements: 1. Nuclear Security Summits are periodically held under aegis of United Nations. 2. International Panel on Fissile Materials is an organ of International Atomic Energy Agency.
explanation: Nuclear Security Summits were initiated by USA not UN (statement 1 incorrect). International Panel on Fissile Materials is independent group not IAEA organ (statement 2 incorrect).

subject: Social Security
question_text: Who among the following can join the National Pension System (NPS)?
option_b: Persons of age from 21 to 55 only
option_c: All State Government employees joining services after date of notification by respective State Governments
option_d: All Central Government employees including those of Armed Forces joining services on or after 1st April 2004
explanation: NPS is mandatory for all central government employees (except armed forces) who joined on or after January 1

subject: Geography
question_text: With reference to river Teesta consider the following statements: 1. Source of river Teesta is same as that of Brahmaputra but it flows through Sikkim. 2. River Rangeet originates in Sikkim and it is a tributary of river Teesta. 3. River Teesta flows into Bay of Bengal on border of India and Bangladesh.
explanation: Teesta originates from Pauhunri glacier in Sikkim not same as Brahmaputra (statement 1 incorrect). Rangeet is tributary of Teesta (statement 2 correct). Teesta joins Brahmaputra before Bay of Bengal (statement 3 incorrect).

subject: Health
question_text: Consider the following statements: 1. In tropical regions Zika virus disease is transmitted by same mosquito that transmits dengue. 2. Sexual transmission of Zika virus disease is possible.
explanation: Both statements are correct. Zika is transmitted by Aedes mosquito (same as dengue) and sexual transmission is documented.

subject: Standards
question_text: Consider the following statements: 1. The Standard Mark of Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) is mandatory for automotive tyres and tubes. 2. AGMARK is a quality Certification Mark issued by Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO).
explanation: BIS certification is mandatory for tyres and tubes (statement 1 correct). AGMARK is issued by Directorate of Marketing & Inspection under Agriculture Ministry not FAO (statement 2 incorrect).

subject: Agriculture
question_text: What is/are the advantage/advantages of implementing National Agriculture Market scheme? 1. It is a pan-India electronic trading portal for agricultural commodities. 2. It provides farmers access to nationwide market with prices commensurate with quality of their produce.
explanation: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM) is electronic trading platform connecting APMCs nationwide enabling farmers to get better prices based on quality. Both statements correct.

subject: Intellectual Property
question_text: With reference to National Intellectual Property Rights Policy consider the following statements: 1. It reiterates India's commitment to Doha Development Agenda and TRIPS Agreement. 2. Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion is nodal agency for regulating intellectual property rights in India.
explanation: National IPR Policy 2016 reiterates commitment to TRIPS and Doha Declaration. DIPP (now DPIIT) is nodal agency for IPR. Both statements correct.

subject: Wildlife
question_text: According to Wildlife (Protection) Act 1972 which of the following animals cannot be hunted by any person except under some provisions provided by law? 1. Gharial 2. Indian wild ass 3. Wild buffalo
explanation: All three species - Gharial Indian wild ass and Wild buffalo are listed in Schedule I of Wildlife Protection Act enjoying highest protection.

subject: Constitutional Law
question_text: Which of the following statements is/are true of Fundamental Duties of an Indian citizen? 1. A legislative process has been provided to enforce these duties. 2. They are correlative to legal duties.
explanation: No legislative process exists to enforce Fundamental Duties (statement 1 incorrect). They are correlative to Fundamental Rights not legal duties (statement 2 incorrect).

subject: History
question_text: Consider the following pairs: 1. Radhakanta Deb - First President of British Indian Association 2. Gazulu Lakshminarasu Chetty - Founder of Madras Mahajana Sabha 3. Surendranath Banerjee - Founder of Indian Association
explanation: Radhakanta Deb was first president of British Indian Association (1 correct). Madras Mahajana Sabha was founded by M. Veeraraghavachariar (2 incorrect). Surendranath Banerjee founded Indian Association (3 correct).

subject: Constitutional Law
question_text: Which one of the following objectives is not embodied in the Preamble to the Constitution of India?
explanation: Preamble guarantees liberty of thought expression belief faith and worship but does not explicitly mention economic liberty.

subject: Standards
question_text: With reference to Quality Council of India (QCI) consider the following statements: 1. QCI was set up jointly by Government of India and Indian Industry. 2. Chairman of QCI is appointed by Prime Minister on recommendations of industry to Government.
explanation: QCI established in 1997 jointly by Government and three industry associations - CII FICCI and ASSOCHAM. Chairman appointed by PM based on industry recommendations. Both statements correct.

subject: Banking
question_text: What is the purpose of setting up of Small Finance Banks (SFBs) in India? 1. To supply credit to small business units 2. To supply credit to small and marginal farmers 3. To encourage young entrepreneurs to set up business particularly in rural areas
explanation: Small Finance Banks primarily aim to provide credit to small business units and small/marginal farmers. Statement 3 about encouraging entrepreneurs is not a stated objective.

subject: International Relations
question_text: With reference to Asia Pacific Ministerial Conference on Housing and Urban Development (APMCHUD) consider the following statements: 1. First APMCHUD was held in India in 2006 on theme Emerging Urban Forms - Policy Responses and Governance Structure. 2. India hosts all Annual Ministerial Conferences in partnership with ADB APEC and ASEAN.
explanation: First APMCHUD was in 2006 but not in India (statement 1 incorrect). India does not host all conferences nor are ADB APEC ASEAN permanent partners (statement 2 incorrect).

subject: Political Philosophy
question_text: Democracy's superior virtue lies in the fact that it calls into activity
option_a: the intelligence and character of ordinary men and women
option_b: the methods for strengthening executive leadership
option_c: a superior individual with dynamism and vision
option_d: a band of dedicated party workers
explanation: Democracy's fundamental strength is that it engages intelligence and character of common citizens enabling their participation in governance.

subject: Banking
question_text: Which of the following is a most likely consequence of implementing Unified Payments Interface (UPI)?
option_a: Mobile wallets will not be necessary for online payments
option_b: Digital currency will totally replace physical currency in about two decades
option_d: Direct transfer of subsidies to poor people will become very effective
explanation: UPI enables seamless direct benefit transfers making subsidy delivery more efficient. Other options are not direct or likely consequences of UPI implementation.

subject: Science
question_text: The terms Event Horizon Singularity String Theory and Standard Model are sometimes seen in news in context of
option_a: Observation and understanding of the Universe
option_b: Study of solar and lunar eclipses
option_c: Placing satellites in orbit of Earth
option_d: Origin and evolution of living organisms on Earth
explanation: These are physics and cosmology terms related to understanding universe - black holes (event horizon singularity)

subject: Biotechnology
question_text: With reference to agriculture in India how can the technique of genome sequencing often seen in news be used in immediate future? 1. Genome sequencing can be used to identify genetic markers for disease resistance and drought tolerance in various crop plants. 2. This technique helps in reducing time required to develop new varieties of crop plants. 3. It can be used to decipher host-pathogen relationships in crops.
explanation: Genome sequencing helps identify useful genes (1)
column13: and reveals plant-pathogen interactions (3). All three applications are valid.

subject: Political Theory
question_text: The main advantage of parliamentary form of government is that
option_a: the executive and legislature work independently
option_b: it provides continuity of policy and is more efficient
option_c: the executive remains responsible to the legislature
option_d: the head of government cannot be changed without election
explanation: Parliamentary system's key advantage is executive accountability to legislature ensuring responsible government unlike presidential system.

subject: Political Philosophy
question_text: In the context of India which one of the following is the correct relationship between Rights and Duties?
option_b: Rights are personal and hence independent of society and Duties
option_c: Rights not Duties are important for advancement of personality of citizen
option_d: Duties not Rights are important for stability of State
explanation: Rights and duties are correlative - rights of one person create duties for others and vice versa. They are interdependent for social harmony.

subject: Constitutional Law
question_text: The mind of the makers of the Constitution of India is reflected in which of the following?
option_c: The Directive Principles of State Policy
explanation: Preamble embodies basic philosophy and fundamental values reflecting vision dreams and aspirations of Constituent Assembly makers.

subject: Geography
question_text: If you travel by road from Kohima to Kottayam what is the minimum number of States within India through which you can travel including origin and destination?
explanation: Kohima (Nagaland) to Kottayam (Kerala) minimum route: Nagaland Assam West Bengal Odisha Andhra Pradesh Kerala = 6 states.

subject: Parliamentary Procedure
question_text: The Parliament of India exercises control over functions of Council of Ministers through 1. Adjournment motion 2. Question hour 3. Supplementary questions
explanation: Parliament controls executive through all three - adjournment motion (discusses urgent public importance)

subject: History
question_text: Which one of the following was a very important seaport in the Kakatiya kingdom?
explanation: Motupalli was the most important seaport of Kakatiya kingdom located in present-day Andhra Pradesh facilitating trade with Southeast Asia.

subject: Environment
question_text: With reference to Global Climate Change Alliance which of the following statements is/are correct? 1. It is an initiative of European Union. 2. It provides technical and financial support to targeted developing countries to integrate climate change into their development policies and budgets. 3. It is coordinated by World Resources Institute (WRI) and World Business Council for Sustainable Development (WBCSD).
explanation: Global Climate Change Alliance is EU initiative providing support to developing countries on climate change (statements 1 and 2 correct). It is not coordinated by WRI and WBCSD (statement 3 incorrect).

subject: Religion
question_text: With reference to religious history of India consider the following statements: 1. Sautrantika and Sammitiya were sects of Jainism. 2. Sarvastivadin held that constituents of phenomena were not wholly momentary but existed forever in latent form.
explanation: Sautrantika and Sammitiya were Buddhist sects not Jain (statement 1 incorrect). Sarvastivadin Buddhist philosophy held things exist in past present future (statement 2 correct).

subject: Geography
question_text: Mediterranean Sea is a border of which of the following countries? 1. Jordan 2. Iraq 3. Lebanon 4. Syria
explanation: Mediterranean Sea borders Lebanon and Syria from the given options. Jordan and Iraq do not have Mediterranean coastline.

subject: Infrastructure
question_text: With reference to National Investment and Infrastructure Fund which of the following statements is/are correct? 1. It is an organ of NITI Aayog. 2. It has a corpus of Rs 4
explanation: Neither 1 nor 2
column13: NIIF is an independent entity not organ of NITI Aayog (statement 1 incorrect). Its corpus is Rs 40

subject: International Finance
question_text: The Global Infrastructure Facility is a/an
option_a: ASEAN initiative to upgrade infrastructure in Asia and financed by credit from Asian Development Bank
option_b: World Bank collaboration that facilitates preparation and structuring of complex infrastructure Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) to enable mobilization of private sector and institutional investor capital
option_c: Collaboration among major banks of world working with OECD and focused on expanding set of infrastructure projects that have potential to mobilize private investment
option_d: UNCTAD funded initiative that seeks to finance and facilitate infrastructure development in the world
explanation: Global Infrastructure Facility is World Bank platform facilitating preparation and structuring of bankable infrastructure PPP projects to attract private investment.

subject: Elections
question_text: For election to Lok Sabha a nomination paper can be filed by
option_b: a resident of constituency from which election is to be contested
option_c: any citizen of India whose name appears in electoral roll of a constituency
explanation: Any Indian citizen can file nomination for Lok Sabha election regardless of residence though they contest from specific constituency.

subject: Geography
question_text: Consider the following statements: 1. In India Himalayas are spread over five States only. 2. Western Ghats are spread over five States only. 3. Pulicat Lake is spread over two States only.
explanation: Himalayas spread across more than 5 states (statement 1 incorrect). Western Ghats across 6 states (statement 2 incorrect). Pulicat Lake across Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh (statement 3 correct).

subject: Environment
question_text: Biological Oxygen Demand (BOD) is a standard criterion for
option_b: Computing oxygen levels in forest ecosystems
option_d: Assessing oxygen levels in high altitude regions
explanation: BOD measures amount of dissolved oxygen needed by aerobic organisms to break down organic material in water used to assess water pollution levels.

subject: UN Agencies
question_text: With reference to role of UN-Habitat in United Nations programme working towards better urban future which of the statements is/are correct? 1. UN-Habitat has been mandated by United Nations General Assembly to promote socially and environmentally sustainable towns and cities to provide adequate shelter for all. 2. Its partners are either governments or local urban authorities only. 3. UN-Habitat contributes to overall objective of United Nations system to reduce poverty and to promote access to safe drinking water and basic sanitation.
explanation: UN-Habitat is mandated by UNGA for sustainable urban development (1 correct). It partners with various stakeholders not just governments (2 incorrect). It contributes to poverty reduction and water/sanitation goals (3 correct).

subject: Skill Development
question_text: With reference to National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF) which of the statements given below is/are correct? 1. Under NSQF learner can acquire certification for competency only through formal learning. 2. An outcome expected from implementation of NSQF is mobility between vocational and general education.
explanation: Certification possible through formal non-formal and informal learning (statement 1 incorrect). NSQF enables mobility between vocational and general education streams (statement 2 correct).

subject: History
question_text: In context of Indian history principle of Dyarchy (diarchy) refers to
option_a: Division of central legislature into two houses
option_b: Introduction of double government i.e. Central and State governments
option_c: Having two sets of rulers; one in London and another in Delhi
option_d: Division of subjects delegated to provinces into two categories
explanation: Dyarchy introduced by Government of India Act 1919 divided provincial subjects into Reserved (under Governor) and Transferred (under elected ministers).

subject: Employment
question_text: Consider the following in respect of National Career Service: 1. National Career Service is an initiative of Department of Personnel and Training Government of India. 2. National Career Service has been launched in Mission Mode to improve employment opportunities to uneducated youth of country.
explanation: National Career Service is initiative of Ministry of Labour and Employment not DPT (statement 1 incorrect). It is for all job seekers not just uneducated youth (statement 2 incorrect).

subject: Banking
question_text: Which of the following statements best describes the term Scheme for Sustainable Structuring of Stressed Assets (S4A) recently seen in news?
option_a: It is a procedure for considering ecological costs of developmental schemes formulated by Government
option_b: It is a scheme of RBI for reworking financial structure of big corporate entities facing genuine difficulties
option_c: It is a disinvestment plan of Government regarding Central Public Sector Undertakings
option_d: It is an important provision in The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code recently implemented by Government
explanation: S4A was RBI scheme for resolution of large stressed accounts by bifurcating debt into sustainable and equity/quasi-equity portions.

subject: Climate
question_text: Consider the following statements: 1. Climate and Clean Air Coalition (CCAC) to Reduce Short Lived Climate Pollutants is a unique initiative of G20 group of countries. 2. The CCAC focuses on methane black carbon and hydrofluorocarbons.
explanation: CCAC is voluntary partnership not G20 initiative (statement 1 incorrect). It focuses on short-lived climate pollutants including methane black carbon and HFCs (statement 2 correct).

subject: Climate
question_text: With reference to Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD) sometimes mentioned in news while forecasting Indian monsoon which of the following statements is/are correct? 1. IOD phenomenon is characterised by difference in sea surface temperature between tropical Western Indian Ocean and tropical Eastern Pacific Ocean. 2. An IOD phenomenon can influence an El Nino's impact on monsoon.
explanation: IOD is difference between western and eastern Indian Ocean not Pacific (statement 1 incorrect). Positive IOD can offset negative El Nino impact on monsoon (statement 2 correct).

subject: Wildlife
question_text: If you want to see gharials in their natural habitat which one of the following is the best place to visit?
explanation: Chambal River and its National Chambal Sanctuary is one of best places to see gharials in natural habitat in India.

subject: Defence
question_text: Consider the following in respect of Indian Ocean Naval Symposium (IONS): 1. Inaugural IONS was held in India in 2015 under chairmanship of Indian Navy. 2. IONS is a voluntary initiative that seeks to increase maritime co-operation among navies of littoral states of Indian Ocean Region.
explanation: First IONS was in 2008 not 2015 (statement 1 incorrect). IONS is voluntary forum for maritime cooperation among Indian Ocean littoral navies (statement 2 correct).

subject: Art
question_text: The painting of Bodhisattva Padmapani is one of the most famous and oft-illustrated paintings at
explanation: Famous fresco of Bodhisattva Padmapani holding lotus is located in Cave 1 of Ajanta Caves representing peak of Buddhist art.

subject: Culture
question_text: Consider the following pairs: Traditions - Communities 1. Chaliha Sahib Festival - Sindhis 2. Nanda Raj Jaat Yatra - Gonds 3. Wari-Warkari - Santhals
explanation: Chaliha Sahib is Sindhi tradition (1 correct). Nanda Raj Jaat is Uttarakhand tradition not Gond (2 incorrect). Wari is Maharashtra tradition not Santhal (3 incorrect). None correctly matched.

subject: Agriculture
question_text: Which of the following practices can help in water conservation in agriculture? 1. Reduced or zero tillage of land 2. Applying gypsum before irrigating field 3. Allowing crop residue to remain in field
explanation: Zero tillage and crop residue retention help conserve soil moisture (1 and 3 correct). Gypsum application is for soil improvement not water conservation (2 incorrect).

subject: Agriculture
question_text: Consider the following statements: The nation-wide Soil Health Card Scheme aims at 1. expanding cultivable area under irrigation 2. enabling banks to assess quantum of loans to be granted to farmers on basis of soil quality 3. checking overuse of fertilizers in farmlands.
explanation: Soil Health Card Scheme primarily aims to promote judicious use of fertilizers based on soil nutrient status. Only statement 3 is correct primary objective.

subject: Food Safety
question_text: Consider the following pairs: Commonly used materials - Unwanted chemicals 1. Lipstick - Lead 2. Soft drinks - Brominated vegetable oils 3. Chinese fast food - Monosodium glutamate
explanation: All three pairs correctly matched - lipstick may contain lead soft drinks may have brominated oils Chinese food often contains MSG.

subject: Technology
question_text: Organic Light Emitting Diodes (OLEDs) are used to create digital display in many devices. What are advantages of OLED displays over Liquid Crystal displays? 1. OLED displays can be fabricated on flexible plastic substrates. 2. Roll-up displays embedded in clothing can be made using OLEDs. 3. Transparent displays are possible using OLEDs.
option_d: None of the above statements is correct
explanation: OLEDs offer all three advantages - flexibility for curved/flexible screens (1)

subject: Culture
question_text: Which of the following is/are famous for Sun temples? 1. Arasavalli 2. Amarakantak 3. Omkareshwar
explanation: Arasavalli in Andhra Pradesh has famous Sun temple. Amarakantak and Omkareshwar are Shiva temples not Sun temples.

subject: Electoral Law
question_text: Consider the following statements: 1. In election for Lok Sabha or State Assembly winning candidate must get at least 50 percent of votes polled to be declared elected. 2. According to provisions in Constitution of India in Lok Sabha Speaker's post goes to majority party and Deputy Speaker's to Opposition.
explanation: India follows first-past-the-post not absolute majority (statement 1 incorrect). Deputy Speaker need not be from opposition (statement 2 incorrect).

subject: Economics
question_text: Which of the following has/have occurred in India after its liberalization of economic policies in 1991? 1. Share of agriculture in GDP increased enormously. 2. Share of India's exports in world trade increased. 3. FDI inflows increased. 4. India's foreign exchange reserves increased enormously.
explanation: Agriculture share declined (1 incorrect). Export share FDI inflows and forex reserves all increased after 1991 reforms (2 3 4 correct).

subject: Biotechnology
question_text: What is the application of Somatic Cell Nuclear Transfer Technology?
option_d: Production of organisms free of diseases
explanation: Somatic Cell Nuclear Transfer is technique used for reproductive cloning where nucleus from somatic cell is transferred to enucleated egg cell.

subject: Banking
question_text: Consider the following statements: 1. National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) helps in promoting financial inclusion in country. 2. NPCI has launched RuPay a card payment scheme.
explanation: NPCI facilitates digital payments promoting financial inclusion (1 correct). It launched RuPay domestic card scheme (2 correct). Both statements correct.

subject: Technology
question_text: The term M-STRIPES is sometimes seen in news in context of
explanation: M-STrIPES (Monitoring System for Tigers - Intensive Protection and Ecological Status) is app for tiger reserve management and monitoring.

subject: Economics
question_text: What is/are the most likely advantages of implementing Goods and Services Tax (GST)? 1. It will replace multiple taxes collected by multiple authorities and will thus create single market in India. 2. It will drastically reduce Current Account Deficit of India and enable it to increase foreign exchange reserves. 3. It will enormously increase growth and size of economy of India and enable it to overtake China in near future.
explanation: GST creates unified national market by subsuming multiple indirect taxes (1 correct). It does not directly impact CAD or enable overtaking China (2 and 3 incorrect).

subject: International Trade
question_text: Broad-based Trade and Investment Agreement (BTIA) is sometimes seen in news in context of negotiations held between India and
option_c: Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development
explanation: BTIA negotiations are between India and European Union for comprehensive free trade agreement covering goods services and investments.

subject: Trade
question_text: Consider the following statements: 1. India has ratified Trade Facilitation Agreement (TFA) of WTO. 2. TFA is part of WTO's Bali Ministerial Package of 2013. 3. TFA came into force in January 2016.
explanation: India ratified TFA (1 correct). TFA is part of Bali Package (2 correct). TFA came into force in February 2017 not January 2016 (3 incorrect).

subject: International Relations
question_text: What is the importance of developing Chabahar Port by India?
option_a: India's trade with African countries will enormously increase
option_b: India's relations with oil-producing Arab countries will be strengthened
option_c: India will not depend on Pakistan for access to Afghanistan and Central Asia
option_d: Pakistan will facilitate and protect installation of gas pipeline between Iraq and India
explanation: Chabahar Port in Iran provides India alternative route to Afghanistan and Central Asia bypassing Pakistan enabling trade and connectivity.

subject: Cyber Security
question_text: In India it is legally mandatory for which of the following to report on cyber security incidents? 1. Service providers 2. Data centres 3. Body corporate
explanation: Under IT Act and rules service providers data centres and body corporates are mandated to report cyber security incidents to CERT-In.

subject: Constitutional Law
question_text: Right to vote and to be elected in India is a
explanation: Right to vote is constitutional right conferred by Constitution under Article 326 not a fundamental right which are in Part III.

subject: Space Technology
